segments.translation: 艾丽克斯从来就不像个小孩样

segments.sceneTitle: 怎么回事
segments.text: But Luke is my baby.
segments.translation: 但卢克是我的小宝宝

segments.sceneTitle: 怎么回事
segments.text: Is it really too much to ask
segments.translation: 真的是我太奢望吗

segments.sceneTitle: 怎么回事
segments.text: that he stay a sweet, innocent kid...
segments.translation: 想让他永远当个可爱 纯真的孩子

segments.sceneTitle: 怎么回事
segments.text: forever?
segments.translation: 永远那样

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Hey, buddy. Um- Here. Sorry.
segments.translation: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: We'll dribble later.
segments.translation: 待会儿再拍球

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Um, I just, uh- I just want to say I'm sorry.
segments.translation: 我只是 只是想说我很抱歉

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: I never meant to blame you for that whole picture thing.
segments.translation: 我不是有意让你为那张图片背黑锅

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Your mom sort of thought it was yours
segments.translation: 你妈妈以为那是你的

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: and I should have stopped it, but I didn't.
segments.translation: 我该站出来说实话的 但我没有

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: So what was the picture of?
segments.translation: 那张图片拍的是什么

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Well, it was a woman on a tractor and she had her shirt off.
segments.translation: 是关于一个女人在拖拉机上 没穿上衣

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Was it hot?
segments.translation: 很热吗[性感]

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Okay, we're being honest here.
segments.translation: 好吧 既然要开诚布公

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Um, this particular woman-
segments.translation: 图片中的那个女人

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Well, my tastes do run to the curvy,
segments.translation: 我的确很欣赏她的性感曲线

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: and the cowboy hat did not hurt one bit.
segments.translation: 宽大的牛仔帽并没有破坏整体美

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Couple that with the cutoff jeans-
segments.translation: 和超短牛仔裤相映成趣

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: And you were asking about the weather, weren't you?
segments.translation: 你其实问的是天气热不热 是吧

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Yeah.
segments.translation: 是啊

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Well, this is good. This is good.
segments.translation: 很好 很好

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: You're gonna be going through some changes soon.
segments.translation: 你很快就将经历一些成长变化

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: And I think now you can feel safe talking to me about whatever.
segments.translation: 现在你不管有什么事 都可以放心跟我说了

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: And so it ends.
segments.translation: 一切到此为止

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Sadly, I've been summarily dismissed
segments.translation: 可悲的是 我被仓促地

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: from the employ of Masters Cameron and Mitchell.
segments.translation: 从卡梅隆和米奇尔主人家解雇

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: The former being an utter delight,
segments.translation: 前者是个高尚的正人君子

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: and the latter being a humorless snoot.
segments.translation: 后者则是个毫无幽默感的势利小人

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Just come on. Get him in the car. The thrift shop's closing.
segments.translation: 快点 把他弄上车 旧货店要关门了

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: What is this exciting thrift shop you speak of?
segments.translation: 你说的有趣的旧货店是什么地方

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Many of my relatives were taken out of their homes...
segments.translation: 我的很多亲戚成年后都被赶出家门

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: to be released into the green pastures in their maturity-
segments.translation: 被流放到大草原上自生自灭

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: - Did you just say "Matoority?" - Unhand me, you brute!
segments.translation: -你刚说了"尘脸猴"吗 -放开我 你个禽兽

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: I regret nothing!
segments.translation: 我不后悔

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: I'll pay you. I'm a comfortable man.
segments.translation: 我可以给你钱 我生活富足

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: I've been stealing from your father for days.
segments.translation: 我一直从你父亲那里偷钱

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: Oh, is there any better feeling in the world
segments.translation: 世上有什么能比得上

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: than having your ears flap in the wind?
segments.translation: 让耳朵在风中摇摆的感觉呢

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: You know what? Get out.
segments.translation: 算了 滚出去吧

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: You mean it? Sweet freedom?
segments.translation: 你说真的吗 要放我自由了吗

segments.sceneTitle: 嘿 老弟 听着 抱歉
segments.text: No, not you, Barkley. Cameron, out.
segments.translation: 不 不是说你 巴克利 卡梅隆 滚下车
